title: SkillHouse: Football Circus
summary: Build your footballer's career in an offbeat online RPG. Train, take on jobs, choose equipment and find your club. Follow automatically simulated league matches and make choices at designated moments. An unusual squad. Big goals.
about:
An unusual squad. Big goals.

Muddy boots, a dressing room full of oddballs and a footballer whose future is in your hands. SkillHouse: Football Circus is an online football RPG about one player's career, match preparation and life at a club.


Your footballer, your path

Create a player, choose a position and give them their own look. Pick an eccentric animal character or customise a human footballer. Train abilities, gain experience and decide where to spend your time and energy.


From training ground to dressing room

Earn in-game money through jobs and visit merchants to find equipment with specific bonuses. Compare items and develop your footballer to suit their position and your playing style. Appearance and preparation are part of the same career.


Find a team to call home

Join a club or create your own. Work with teammates, contribute to facilities and help your team climb the league. Club leaders prepare the lineup, tactics and upgrades, while each member develops their own footballer.


Prepare for the match. Follow the action.

League matches are automatically simulated by the game server. Follow movement on the pitch, commentary, scores and statistics. At designated decision moments, choose your footballer's next action. Revisit the action in a replay after the match.


Explore beyond the stadium

Higher levels unlock the Galactic Bridge, with expeditions and materials. Build your collection and discover more ways to develop your character alongside your league career.


Free to play

Football Circus is free to play. Planned optional purchases for the Steam version include the premium SkillCoin Cash currency (SC), which can be used for VIP and other premium features. VIP provides bonuses to experience and in-game income. Each purchase will show its price and contents before confirmation.

A continuous internet connection and a SkillHouse account are required. Progress is stored on the game server. Mouse and keyboard controls.
